sections.title: Overview
sections.html:
Complaint in the complainant's language. Draft in the station's.

Writing a first information report by hand is slow, and key details get missed. The complainant explains what happened in their own language; the report is written in another, and meaning is lost in between. AI CopWriter handles all three problems: record, understand, check.

The problem

Language gap

Complainants explain what happened in their own language. The report is written in another, and meaning gets lost in between.

Time at the desk

The officer writes, re-reads and rewrites the statement by hand while the complainant waits.

Missing details

If the place, time, accused or motive is not recorded, the case is weaker from the first day.

How it works · one complaint, word by word

  1. SpeaksThe complainant speaks in the language they are comfortable in, or types.
  2. CapturedEvery word is written down as it is spoken, with the original audio kept.
  3. TranslatedTurned into clear English, with the source text preserved alongside.
  4. StructuredPlaced into the report's five Ws and one H: what, where, when, who, whom, why, how.
  5. CheckedGaps flagged before filing — a missing motive is raised, not silently left blank.

Languages supported

TeluguHindiEnglish TamilKannadaMalayalam MarathiBengaliGujarati OdiaPunjabi

The language can also be detected automatically.

What the station gets

  • Live transcription — text appears on screen while the complainant is still speaking.
  • Petition scanning — reads petitions from PDF or photographs into editable text.
  • Speaker separation — shows who said what when the officer and complainant both speak.
  • Quality audit — a 12-point report marks each element present, partial or missing, and works out any delay in reporting.
  • Searchable records — every complaint saved with its original audio, ready to search, replay and edit.
  • Secure access — personal logins per officer, an admin panel, and records stored on the department's own server.
Citizen-facing variant. Within GARUDA, the same engine also runs as a citizen complaint writer on a station kiosk, the web or a phone: it asks follow-up questions for missing details, reads the complaint back before submitting, finds the right station from the location, and sends the citizen a copy.

sections.title: Safeguards
sections.html:
Safeguards

What it will not do, and what it always keeps.

  • The original audio is always kept beside the draft.
  • Gaps are flagged, never silently filled.
  • Records stay on the department's own server.
